data.name: Ammarah
data.gender_notes: Ammarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ammarah is an Arabic name that means prosperous and builder. It is derived from the word 'amara which means 'to build'. The name Ammarah carries the meaning “Prosperous, Builder” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Ammarah usually hope their child will grow to embody prosperous, builder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ammarah signifies one who builds and contributes to the prosperity of the society.
data.etymology: Ammarah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prosperous, Builder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ammarah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عمارة
in_arabic.meaning: العمارة اسم مشتق من العمر الطويل و الحياة الدائمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: العمارة اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و معناه البناء أو المكان الذي يعمر طويلاً، و يدل على طول العمر و دوام الحياة، و في بعض الأحيان يأتي بمعنى القوة و الصلاح. و قد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران: ﴿وَأَعْمَرَها﴾، و هو من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية لما يحمل من معاني إيجابية و طيبة.

in_urdu.name: عمارہ
in_urdu.meaning: عمارہ کا مطلب ہے دیرپا زندگی اور لمبی عمر
in_urdu.long_meaning: عمارہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے عمارت یا دیرپا رہائش گاہ، یہ نام طویل عمر، مسلسل وجود اور بعض اوقات طاقت اور خوبی کے مفہوم کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں خاصی اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ ایک مثبت اور امید افزا معنی رکھتا ہے۔ اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے، جہاں یہ دائمی اثر و رسوخ کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अम्माराह
in_hindi.meaning: अम्माराह का अर्थ है स्थायी जीवन और लंबी उम्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: अम्माराह एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है स्थायी निवास या लंबी उम्र, यह नाम न केवल समय की लंबाई को दर्शाता है बल्कਿ आध्यात्मिक और व्यक्तिगत विकास की समृद्धि को भी दर्शाता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत पसंद किया जाता है क्योंकि यह सकारात्मक अर्थ और अच्छे गुणों का प्रतीक है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम अक्सर अच्छे चरित्र और मजबूत आध्यात्मिकता के साथ जुड़ा होता है।

in_pashto.name: عمارہ
in_pashto.meaning: عمارہ د اوږد عمر او دوامداره ژوند معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عمارہ د عربي اصل يو نوم دی چې په پښتو کې د اوږد عمر، دوامداره هستوګنځي او ځواکمنۍ معنی لري. دا نوم په افغان او پښتني کلتور کې د مثبتو او ښو صفاتو د يو سمبول په توګه کارول کېږي. دا نوم د تاريخي او مذهبي پلوه د منلو وړ دی او په اسلامي دود کې د يو ښوګړی نوم په توګه پېژندل شوی دی.

in_english.name: Ammarah
in_english.meaning: Ammarah means long life, prosperity, and strong existence
in_english.long_meaning: Ammarah is an Arabic-originated name that signifies long life, permanent residence, and sometimes strength and goodness. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'عمر' (ʿ-m-r), it relates to the concepts of longevity and continuous existence. The name appears in the Quranic context, symbolizing eternal impact and spiritual growth. In Islamic tradition, Ammarah is associated with positive attributes such as resilience, strong character, and enduring legacy. Across Muslim cultures, the name Ammarah is cherished for its profound meaning and historical significance.

It is a name that resonates with the spirit of innovation, productivity, and improvement, especially in the context of building communities, whether physically or spiritually.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ammarah is a reminder of the immense potential each individual holds to build themselves, their families, and their spiritual lives. It is a call to action to strive for personal growth and to contribute to the development of the community, following the example of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) who built a prosperous and thriving Islamic community in Medina. By embodying the spirit of construction and growth, the name Ammarah inspires individuals to strive for a life of continuous improvement, self-betterment, and the betterment of those around them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ammarah: The steadfast one, a beacon of resilience and perseverance in the face of adversity, Ammarah's name echoes the unwavering spirit that refuses to yield to hardships, inspiring strength and determination in all who bear it.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that She was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and one of the wives of Ali ibn Abi Talib. The name Ammarah carried significant weight in that era.
